title: The Real Python Podcast – Episode #319: Mentoring Developers Beyond the Code With Tim Schilling
description: What's it take to be a mentor to developers? Where in an engineer's career can a mentor make an impact? This week we speak with Tim Schilling, Django Steering Council member and Djangonaut Space administrator, about mentoring Python developers.
